skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions sharing that denominator.

skills.name: Same-Denominator Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators directly once two fractions share a common denominator.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to its lowest terms when the raw subtraction result is not already fully reduced.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole (as denominator/denominator) from the whole-number part and add it to the numerator before subtracting.

skills.name: Whole-and-Fraction Part Separation
skills.definition: Separate the whole-number and fractional components of mixed numbers or whole numbers (treating a whole number as whole+0/d) and subtract each part independently.

skills.name: Improper Mixed-Number Normalization
skills.definition: Recognize a mixed number whose fractional part's numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator and convert it into standard whole-plus-proper-fraction form before/while subtracting.
